list: The official 55 trophies as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase on 18 November 2026 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden). Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written for this entry, in its own words, and names the launch guides it draws on.
note: All 55 trophies are single-player and offline. There are no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off on your trophy save.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you will earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing to do for it directly. One playthrough is enough and no multiplayer or DLC is needed, so just work the list below in order and it will come to you. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, with the 100% completion trophy the longest single step.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so just play it through to the end and the trophy pops when it wraps up. Nothing before it needs doing first — this is where every playthrough starts.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops as the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in the game that may not wait for you: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house, the morning after the mission Down to Earth — it feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy and the offer is gone once the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through Chapter 2 to its end and it pops as the chapter closes. This is the chapter where Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up most of the side list — several trophies need both of them, so from here on, swap characters freely and try things as they unlock.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 and it pops at the chapter's end. The robbery trophies start opening up around Chapters 3 and 4, so once you are here, keep an eye out for bank vaults, armored trucks and illegal operations while you play the story — they all count later too, nothing here is timed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4 and it pops as the chapter closes. The story runs five chapters in total and takes roughly 60 to 80 hours, so you are past the bulk of it now — one chapter left, then free roam and the long cleanup toward 100%.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, and the only gold one tied to the plot. Finish the final mission and it pops with the credits. After the story you are returned to free roam, so nothing is locked behind the ending — and this is when the 100% Completion Checklist finally becomes visible under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Breakfast Run is a main-story mission: play it through and the trophy pops when it ends. There is no mission replay in this game, but story trophies cannot be missed — as long as you finish the mission, the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. The Cartel Heist is a main-story mission — complete it and the trophy pops. Heist missions are usually the longer, set-piece ones, so take your time with the setup beats; failing and retrying a story mission costs nothing toward trophies.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Child's Play is a main-story mission: finish it and the trophy pops. Like every story trophy, it unlocks automatically as you play — no side requirement, no choice to make, just complete the mission.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Headliners is a main-story mission: complete it and the trophy pops. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway — there is no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your only way back if you ever want to redo a story beat.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. VCIA Takedown is a main-story mission set around Vice City International Airport: finish it and the trophy pops. The airport itself matters for another trophy later — Catch Me If You Can, leaving VCIA by an unscheduled departure — so get a feel for the runways and hangars while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Operation Savage Glory is a main-story mission: complete it and the trophy pops. It is one of the twelve story trophies (eleven bronze and one gold) that unlock automatically as the five chapters play out — none of them can be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the longest step on the road to the platinum. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist — progress you made during the story already counts toward it. The thresholds are lenient: it is closer to 60% true completion, needing 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 300 stunts and 70 of the 80 challenges. Work it after the credits, when everything on it is still reachable in free roam, and most of it will already be done from chasing the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts spread across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Mix them — bridges and ramps are the quickest to rack up — and note that the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 and the extra 50 count toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — one go at each is enough, you do not need to win or finish anything. The types are the game's side activities: racing, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, drone racing, meditation, hunting and the rest of the leisure map icons. Wander the map in free roam, dip into one of each, and check the Progress menu to see which types you have tried.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Head to a shooting range, pick a challenge, and beat its gold time or score — you can retry each one as often as you like, so treat the first runs as practice and learn the target patterns before pushing for gold. The ranges also count toward the 100% checklist, so this is not wasted effort.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one of them, not 14 wins at the same spot. Learn each course's turns on a practice run, then race it for real — drone races are also on the 100% checklist, so they do double duty.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each event counts once, so you need twenty distinct race events, not twenty wins at the same one. Work through the race icons across Leonida in any vehicle class you like; street races, off-road and any other race type all count. Losing does not lock anything, so just retry an event until you take it.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find a fishing spot, start the challenge against Cal, and out-fish him — the fishing minigame is about timing your casts and reeling steadily rather than mashing, so take a practice cast first to learn the rhythm. One win is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, pick any game on it, and play it through to its end — you do not need a high score or a perfect run, just a completed game. Any cabinet counts, so take the shortest game on offer.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Andy is one of the side characters with a questline of their own — take their missions as they appear on the map, follow the strand to its end, and the trophy pops when the last one is done. Side-character quest givers come back after the story, so you can finish this in free roam if you missed any of it during the chapters.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Kenton's missions as they show up, follow the strand to its end, and the trophy pops on the last one. Like the other side-character strands, this can be finished after the story in free roam — the quest givers return once the credits roll.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies, the full official list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Work through Billy's missions in order and the trophy pops when the final one is complete. Billy's strand is one of six side-character questlines in the hidden list, and all of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies, the full official list

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons across Leonida — each strand is a small chain of missions for a stranger, and you need eight full chains. Not every side questline counts toward this one, and the guide writers are still confirming exactly which strands qualify, so work through every stranger you meet rather than cherry-picking. They can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Randy's missions as they appear and follow the strand to its end — the trophy pops on the last one. Randy is one of the side characters whose questline survives the story, so this is safe to leave until free roam.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies, the full official list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Work through Tyrone's missions in order; the trophy pops when the final one is complete. Like the other five side-character strands, it stays open after the story ends.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT MAY BE MISSABLE — do this carefully. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations across Leonida. The first spot is Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth: follow her out and take the optional meditation, because the offer is gone once Chapter 1 ends and nobody has confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it. The last spot only opens once Jason and Lucia are both playable, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy needs three more than A Long Road does — and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until it pops.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's questline is about tracking down specific animals — follow his missions, find the unique animal he names, and take it down with a clean hunt. Bret's quest is also part of the 100% checklist, so it pulls double duty toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies, the full official list

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets out of the 18 sets hidden around Leonida. Cards are tucked into the world — interiors, landmarks, out-of-the-way corners — so pick three sets and hunt their cards one set at a time rather than grabbing at random. The in-game Progress menu tracks which cards you have, and finishing sets also feeds the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo-and-share feature: open it at a spot, snap the location, and move on — each distinct location counts once, so keep moving and cover new ground rather than repeating the same street. Track your count in the Progress menu and fold it into your exploration runs, since you will be crossing the map for other trophies anyway.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. There are eight groups of ten, covering combat, driving, exploration and the rest of the game's systems, and you can watch your progress in the Progress menu from the start. Pick the easiest groups first — the trophy only needs 50, and the 100% checklist wants 70, so you can skip the hardest twenty entirely.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTASpotter — GTA VI trophies, the full official list

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it somewhere with escape routes — back alleys, the highway, the water — and keep your partner in the vehicle with you until the stars clear. The wanted level has to be lost, not waited out in hiding forever: break line of sight, keep moving, and let the search cool down. It pops once you are clear with your partner still with you.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is the opposite of Hot Together: here you must KEEP the heat the whole way. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them one after another, and keep the cops on you between robberies without getting caught or letting the stars drop. A fast car parked outside each shop and a straight run between them is the way to do it.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan them with the binoculars or camera as you meet them on the road and in the world. Every new model you spot counts, so vary where you drive: city streets, highways, the countryside and the docks all have different traffic. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so keep scanning past 100 and the rest counts toward A Long Road.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group — a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff — then trigger Combat Focus when several enemies are in view and drop five before the effect ends. Pick a spot with cover nearby so you can keep the focus going, and use a weapon with a fast fire rate.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA by air without a scheduled flight. Grab a plane from the airport and take off on your own terms, or find another way out of the airfield that is not the front gate. The airport is the same one from the VCIA Takedown story mission, so you will already know its layout.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: WikiGTAVI — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. This one sits in the robberies-and-heat group of the hidden list: get a wanted level high enough that the military rolls in Rhinos, then take one on — steal one, destroy one, or survive the encounter, depending on how the moment plays out. A high wanted level in open ground is the way to draw them out.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: WikiGTAVI — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean, silent job. Case the store first, go in quiet, keep the staff and cameras from raising the alarm, and get out before anyone knows you were there. If you are spotted, leave and try again: the trophy only counts a run where nobody detects you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vaults open up with the robbery content in Chapters 3 and 4 — plan each job with a getaway car ready outside, grab the take, and break away clean before the response closes in. You need five successful vault robberies with escapes, and the count is tracked across the whole game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — intercept one, crack it open, take the cash, and get away before the escort and the cops pin you down. A fast getaway vehicle staged nearby makes the escape the easy part; the hard part is stopping the truck in the first place.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive, fly and walk the whole map — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the small towns and the highways between them — until every named area has been visited. The in-game map shades in what you have seen, so sweep the edges and the corners last, where an unvisited pocket is easiest to miss.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
HowToVideoGame — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Gang operations are marked around the map — hit one per gang, nine in total, and keep count of which gangs you have already robbed so you do not repeat one. Operations respawn, so if you fail one you can come back and try again.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet; PowerPyx lists this as one of the five trophies whose method is not yet known. The description points the way: head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view over the water, and order a cocktail there. Try the beachfront bars at sunset, sit where the ocean is in view, and order a drink — if it does not pop, try another beachfront spot. Check the linked guides for updates as players confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this as one of the five trophies whose method is not yet known. The description is the clue: drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass frontage and out the other side, in the classic style of the old games. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build up speed on the street outside, and smash through it. If it does not pop, try a different showroom — check the linked guides for a confirmed spot.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
WikiGTAVI — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throws. Head to the alley, start a game, and bowl — the trophy is about playing it through, so finish the game rather than walking out halfway. Bowling is also one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — the guide writers have not pinned down what counts yet. The description points at a partnership moment with mass appeal: play the partner content with Jason and Lucia together and look for a moment that draws a crowd — a public stunt, a shared activity, or a duo moment the game flags. Keep it in mind during co-op partner play and check the linked guides as players confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: WikiGTAVI — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements
CryptoGames — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements

trophies.guide: Make choices across the game — dialogue picks, story decisions and the small either-or moments — until the count is reached. PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this one, so it builds up naturally over a full playthrough: just keep choosing instead of skipping, and do not rush past conversations. If it has not popped by the end of the story, keep playing the side content and making choices there.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles trophy list (count tracked to 500)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this as one of the five trophies whose method is not yet known. The description suggests failing at something, then succeeding on the second try: a retry that lands. The likeliest candidates are a minigame or challenge you can fail and redo — try failing once, then winning the same thing straight after. Check the linked guides for a confirmed trigger as players work it out.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
WikiGTAVI — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — PowerPyx lists this as one of the five trophies whose method is not yet known, and the description reads like a reaction to something strange. The likeliest reading is a hidden encounter or easter egg somewhere in Leonida — the kind of odd event you stumble on while exploring. Keep exploring the odd corners of the map, and check the linked guides for a confirmed location as players find it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
WikiGTAVI — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED METHOD — the precise trigger is still being confirmed, though the description is clear enough: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive past a pedestrian at speed and swing a melee weapon from the car window — a bat or similar — and connect. Pick a quiet street so you can line the pass up cleanly, and mind the wanted level that follows.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — they are dirty money, and your contacts will clean them for a cut. Keep laundering after every big job rather than sitting on the bills, and the total builds up: $250,000 laundered in total, not in one go.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — every shop in the game counts toward the one total, so just buy things as you play: clothes, weapons, car mods, food, whatever you need. It adds up fast across a full playthrough, and the big-ticket purchases — vehicles and property — push it over the line quickly if you are short at the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties across Leonida. Each garage has one parking spot, and they are the cheapest properties on the market — the Mitchel Auto Center goes for $4,000, and the rest are in the same range. Check the property listings as you travel, buy each garage when you find it, and the trophy pops when the eighth deed is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your phone, pick a vehicle you own or have found, and register it — repeat with ten different vehicles. Any vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most, and grab new ones off the street when you need fresh registrations.
trophies.name: On the Spot
